使重現；使重新發生；再次進行

example: Police officers re-enacted the crime in an attempt to get witnesses to come forward.
員警重現了犯罪的經過，目的是讓目擊證人主動站出來。

NONE: › an occasion on which people re-enact an event

NONE: › to go back to a place where you were earlier or to an activity that you did or were doing earlier
